tools.name: get_rates
tools.description: Latest or a single day's exchange rates. The raw-rate companion to `convert`. With `provider`, published rates from one or more institutions: on its own base the digits are as published, with the date they took effect.

tools.name: convert
tools.description: Convert an amount from one currency to another. Returns {amount, currency} rounded to the target's minor units. Upstream rounds rates per direction; for low-value sources, flip via `get_rates` for more precision. Pass `provider` to use one institution's published rate, e.g. UST for a U.S. Treasury r

tools.name: list_currencies
tools.description: List all supported ISO 4217 currency codes and their full names (e.g. { 'USD': 'United States Dollar' }).

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: List the institutions whose rates Frankfurter relays, with key, rate type, frequency (daily, weekly, monthly or quarterly) and coverage dates. Use a key as `provider` in `convert` or `get_rates` for that institution's published rates instead of the blend.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_providers" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
